name: breed_animals
desc: feed two adult animals of one kind in your pen (or near you) with their food so a baby is born: wheat for cows/sheep, carrots/potatoes for pigs, seeds for chickens

cooldown.text: breeding did not work here: need 2 adult animals of one kind in the pen and their food; parents rest 5 min after breeding, a baby needs 20 min to grow, and a pen is kept at 4-6 animals of a kind
cooldown.hint: harvest wheat from the farm, or lure more animals into the pen first; with 6 or more of one kind take meat (pen_slaughter) instead
